app.title: 4-Letter Relationship Preference Snapshot | DopaBrain
app.description: A transparent 12-choice relationship-preference reflection. Not an official MBTI assessment or compatibility score.

intro.title: How do you tend to connect?
intro.sub: Choose what feels closer in everyday relationship situations. There are no right answers.
intro.boundary: This author-created activity is not an official MBTI® assessment. It cannot predict relationship success or another person’s intentions.
intro.methodTitle: How the four letters are chosen
intro.method: Each answer adds one point to one letter on its shown axis. The higher letter is displayed; a tie uses your first answer on that axis.

questions.q1: On a first date with someone new, I...
questions.q1a: Start the conversation and lead the mood 😄
questions.q1b: Wait for them to talk to me first 😊
questions.q2: When planning a date with my partner...
questions.q2a: I decide spontaneously in the moment 🎲
questions.q2b: I plan and prepare in advance 📋
questions.q3: When my partner is having a hard time, I...
questions.q3b: Empathize and comfort their feelings first 💕
questions.q5: The most important thing in a relationship is...
questions.q5b: Happiness and joy in the present moment 🌈
questions.q6a: Try to talk it out right away 🗣️
questions.q7: How I express love to my partner...
questions.q9: My decision-making style in love is...
questions.q10: Activities I want to do with my partner...
questions.q11: My criteria for choosing a partner...

result.summary: These letters are shorthand for the choices you made today.
result.boundary: It does not establish your personality or compatibility. Preferences can change by person and situation.
result.nextAction: Turn this into a real conversation

E.title: Outward energy
E.body: You chose more answers about talking or acting things through.

I.title: Private energy
I.body: You chose more answers about pausing or processing inwardly.

S.title: Concrete cues
S.body: You chose more answers grounded in present details and direct signals.

N.title: Possibilities
N.body: You chose more answers focused on patterns and what might be.

T.title: Reasoning first
T.body: You chose more answers that begin with logic or problem-solving.

F.title: Values first
F.body: You chose more answers that begin with feelings or relational values.

J.title: Structure
J.body: You chose more answers favoring plans, clarity, or closure.

P.title: Flexibility
P.body: You chose more answers favoring room to adapt or stay open.
